how difficult it is for those who trust in money to enter into the kingdom of God!

Erant autem in via ascendentes Jerosolymam:
Now they were on the way ascending to Jerusalem.
et præcedebat illos Jesus, et stupebant:
And Jesus went ahead of them, and they were astonished.
And those following him were afraid.
And again, taking aside the twelve,
cœpit illis dicere quæ essent ei eventura.
he began to tell them what was about to happen to him.
“For behold, we are going up to Jerusalem,
et Filius hominis tradetur principibus sacerdotum,
and the Son of man will be handed over to the leaders of the priests,
and to the scribes, and the elders.

and they will hand him over to the Gentiles.
et illudent ei, et conspuent eum,

and scourge him, and put him to death.

we wish that whatever we will ask,

one at your right and the other at your left, in your glory.”
“You do not know what you are asking.
potestis bibere calicem, quem ego bibo,
Are you able to drink from the chalice from which I drink,
aut baptismo, quo ego baptizor, baptizari?
or to be baptized with the baptism with which I am to be baptized?”
“Indeed, you shall drink from the chalice,
and you shall be baptized with the baptism,
with which I am to be baptized.
But to sit at my right,
is not mine to give to you,
but it is for those for whom it has been prepared.”

et principes eorum potestatem habent ipsorum.
and their leaders exercise authority over them.
Non ita est autem in vobis,
But it is not to be this way among you.
whoever would become greater shall be your minister;
et quicumque voluerit in vobis primus esse, erit omnium servus.
and whoever will be first among you shall be the servant of all.
et Filius hominis non venit ut ministraretur ei,
the Son of man has not come so that they would minister to him,
et daret animam suam redemptionem pro multis.
but so that he would minister and would give his life as a redemption for many.”
And as he was setting out from Jericho with his disciples and a very numerous multitude,
Qui cum audisset quia Jesus Nazarenus est,
And when he had heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth,
he began to cry out and to say,
Et comminabantur ei multi ut taceret.
And many admonished him to be quiet.
But he cried out all the more,
Et stans Jesus præcepit illum vocari.
And Jesus, standing still, instructed him to be called.
And they called the blind man, saying to him:
he leapt up and went to him.
And in response, Jesus said to him, “What do you want,
that I should do for you?”
And the blind man said to him,
your faith has made you whole.”
and he followed him on the way.
